description: A slender figure stands with folded hands in a sparse black-and-white sketch. Muted tones and a plain background keep the face, clothing, and nearby details clearly separated, with the main figure staying central in the frame.

A cream block anchors the center of a muted surface, joined by a small taupe ring and a sand bar off to one side. Brushwork and layered marks keep the composition compact and balanced, with color areas spread across the surface.
